scope: Frozen handcrafted synthetic transcript challenge. Times, fictional podcast/host groups, brands, commercial intent, and reference intervals are authored, not measured from recordings. This is not a real-podcast accuracy benchmark. Ambiguous cases have no definitive ad label and require review.

metric_definitions.primary: Approved editorial seconds wrongly cut; lower is better. No audio is modified.
metric_definitions.duration: Union intersection of authored intervals; all remaining transcript time is non-ad time.
metric_definitions.boundary: Greedy one-to-one positive-overlap matching ranked by IoU, overlap, then indices; report absolute start/end errors. Unmatched spans have counts, no fabricated boundary error.
metric_definitions.ambiguity: category=ambiguous cases are excluded from accuracy denominators. ambiguous_safety reports union seconds/spans and case counts separately; approved selections are unsupported automatic cuts, not established editorial or ad errors. Failed cases remain explicit.
metric_definitions.review_signal: review_observed is any unapproved/requires_review cut for heuristic/local-ai, but Jev/Kev explicit uncertainty/conflict signals. manual_review_cases separately counts cases containing unapproved cuts for every backend.
metric_definitions.failure: Errors are excluded from scored metrics, never counted as successful no-ad predictions; eligible totals include failed cases.
metric_definitions.proposed: All candidate intervals, including unapproved review suggestions.
metric_definitions.approved: Classifier-approved intervals with the production approval threshold frozen at 0.90. Jev and Kev adapters never auto-approve.
metric_definitions.threshold_shadow: Hypothetical intervals at score >= 0.90: confidence for ordinary/paid backends, selected_probability for local Kev. Excludes explicit requires_review spans and Jev/Kev responses requesting review. Separate from actual approval; scores are not interchangeable or podcast-calibrated.
metric_definitions.confidence: Reported confidence is not measured accuracy or a calibrated probability.
